# Universal Wait for Internet

> [!WARNING]
> This mod is deprecated: THIS MOD HAS BEEN DEPRECATED AND WILL NOT RECEIVE UPDATES

This mod is used to help wait until an active internet connection is established. By default, it will attempt to access https://www.linuxserver.io/. If after 60s a connection cannot be established, it will wait for 10s before attempting again.

Add it to any LinuxServer.io container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-wait-for-internet
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-wait-for-internet|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/universal-wait-for-internet/
